sanskrit_verse:
अध्यासनात् समारभ्य भुक्तिर् यस्याविघातिनी ।
त्रिंशद्वर्षाण्य् अविच्छिन्ना तस्य तां न विचालयेत् ॥२८॥
transliteration:
adhyāsanāt samārabhya bhuktir yasyāvighātinī /
triṃśadvarṣāṇy avicchinnā tasya tāṃ na vicālayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has uninterruptedly enjoyed a right or possession for thirty years without dispute, beginning from the time of assumption—his claim shall remain unchallenged.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is established through uninterrupted conscious engagement over time
Causation aligns with continuous manifestive assertion in consciousness
Capacity-based responsibility arises from sustained alignment with ownership
Restoration logic honors the completion of manifested tenure
Consciousness alignment validates enduring, uncontested presence
executable_legal_axioms: IF possession is uninterrupted AND uncontested AND spans 30 years THEN ownership rights are irrevocably affirmed
IF claimant demonstrates continuous manifestive assertion THEN no challenge shall disturb the settled state
IF duration exceeds three decades without conflict THEN adjudication systems MUST recognize inviolable status
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a claimant establishes three decades of uninterrupted and uncontested enjoyment, all lower claims dissolve by default. The threshold of responsibility lies not in proof of origin but in evidence of sustained alignment with dharma of ownership.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is fulfilled through experiential continuity; anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as lawful succession of undisturbed use; proportional responsibility reflects alignment with cosmic order; reality is non-punitive as it confirms what consciousness has already completed.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion acknowledgment process: Recognize and seal the finalized tenure
Responsibility assumption protocol: Confirm that the holder has fully embodied stewardship
Integrity reintegration mechanism: Align societal recognition with factual harmony
Capacity restoration affirmation: Reinforce the individual's sovereign alignment with sustained possession
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: uninterrupted possession for thirty years establishes irrefutable ownership. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
